description: Append-only run log. One run = one conversation (meeting transcript or chat export) + one opportunity, existing or created by the run. Events are never edited or deleted.

run_record.transcript_ref: the conversation as the seller added it (file name, format, source); the text itself is not copied into the log
run_record.run_status: Awaiting review | Approved | Edited and approved | Written automatically | Rejected | Blocked

field_decisions.previous_value: Interested in improving shipment tracking (from inbound web form)
field_decisions.agent_proposal: Real-time shipment tracking visibility for customers

evidence.speaker: Marina Lopes (Acme Logistics)
evidence.quote: Real-time tracking visibility for our customers, that is the priority.

field_decisions.seller_decision: approve | edit | reject | keep | replace | clear
field_decisions.final_value: Real-time shipment tracking visibility for customers
field_decisions.reverted_at: set when the seller pressed Undo on a field written under Always allow

source.format: vtt | srt | otter | kit | plain | whatsapp

target.kind: new (only when no open opportunity matched)
target.client_id: CLI-0xx or null for a new client

event.action: run_created | opportunity_matched | access_checked | opportunity_read | transcript_checked | agent_called | agent_answered | output_validated | proposals_generated | review_ready | field_decided | client_created | opportunity_created | opportunity_not_created | crm_write_attempted | crm_write_result | crm_write_reverted | run_blocked
event.detail: free text, e.g. 'transcript_status=incomplete; last timestamp 00:04:12 of 45 min'
